What a crazy day! All week I was buying wristbands for around $125 and selling for $200 working toward the longshot of getting myself into the festival. I did have a ride with accommodations the night before but I had promised my dearly neglected we could go see P!nk and I wasn't about to back out as I already did with Smashing Pumpkins and Scab Temple Pilots a few months prior so I could go see Tesla.

Had given up on even going when a total stranger I spoke to the day before when I was still selling tickets asked me if I still needed a ride. This was almost 1pm, well past the window for comfortably making it but he was a Coachella pro who knows how to drive to events. We had a mutual friend on Facebook so it was safe! I still had 2 wristbands left and made a good deal to pass off the extra to the ride who was trying to get friends on board for the other night.

Anyway hopped out of the car in traffic still and ran toward entrance as it was a few minutes til showtime. Went through first checkpoint and BAM, scanned as invalid. Box office said the original ticketholder was able to cancel tickets. A LOT of people successfully charged back when Ozzy canceled. People are only trickling in, I have $155 cash on me. Start loudly hitting people up while wondering if I am just going to find my way to the Greyhound station and go home. The whole reason I was even interested in Iron Maiden was all the Somewhere In Time tracks - at the beginning of the set. Not like I would even cross the street for an otherwise Shitstew heavy set. The first 2 people with extras declined my offer of $155, then suddenly someone accepted. They were also buying cheap on Craigslist. IN. Already well past 6:45 start time and I hit record and start running as I can hear the Blade Runner theme in the distant background. Only slowed down to hobble through the ADA entrances. You can hear all this on the recording.

Finally make it into GA performance area halfway through first song and decided with the blood still pumping so fast it was the perfect opportunity to spark up my joint knowing it would hit the head faster. And that's when everything goes from vividly alive to a total blur for the duration.

Metallica is officially released, I moved around a lot and I left during the last song deciding that was easier than walking several miles back by myself.

These are only put up as a formality as the fried_morals sources are likely superior but I wanted to listen once more before filing away.

Eventually got my money back from the seller, I had actually walked her through the invoice process, the only way I buy off strangers on the internet so when she tried to stiff me on shipping I got that back too. Still short $11 but she was such a total moron that I decided to just let it go.
